intro_line: Sun-washed promenades, painted old streets, and the sea right at the door.
intro: Nice rewards visitors who wander: the Old Town, the Promenade des Anglais, and easy day trips along the Riviera all sit close together. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
transit_facts: Tram line 2 links the airport with the centre (Jean Médecin). It runs about every 8 minutes on weekdays, roughly 04:30 to after midnight.
Lignes d'Azur buses charge €1.70 a ride, with a transfer allowed within 74 minutes. Buy a top-up card or pay with contactless. Always validate.
Taxis are pricey and some overcharge. Uber and Bolt both operate, with a ride-share pick-up zone at the airport.
Driving is hard in the centre: one-way streets and scarce metered parking. Use an underground car park, roughly €8-10 a day.
The centre is walkable. Old Town and the seafront are close. Shared bikes and e-scooters are available in parts of the city.
Ferries run from Nice port to Corsica. Check local schedules before you go.

airports.name: Nice Côte d'Azur Airport
airports.note: Main airport for Nice, on a landfill at the western edge, about 7 km from the centre.

options.to: Old Town via Promenade des Anglais
options.note: Runs roughly 05:30 to 21:00. Use the underpass to reach Terminal 1 from the outbound stop.
Ride free to Grand Arénas, then buy a €1.70 ticket for the rest of your trip. Cheapest option is the free ride plus the regular ticket.
Use the marked ride-share zone. Traffic can slow it down.
Agree the fare or check the meter. Taxi drivers at the rank have a reputation for overcharging.
